dmcnerney@supremecourt.gov 

Re:  Mount Lemmon Fire District v. John Guido, et al., No. 17-587 

Dear Ms. McNerney,  

I am Counsel of Record for Petitioner Mount Lemmon Fire District in the 

above-captioned case.  Petitioner’s merits brief is currently due on April 12, 2018.  
In the timeframe in which Petitioner’s brief is due, I have had or will have the 
following matters to attend to:  

  A Petition for Certiorari arising out of Vazquez v. Sessions, No. 16-

60211 (5th Cir. 2018).  

  A Petition for Certiorari arising out of Federal Housing Finance 

Agency v. Nomura Holding America, Inc., No. 15-1872 (2d Cir. 2017), 
due March 12, 2018. 

  Petitioner’s Reply Brief in Hughes v. United States, No. 17-155 (U.S.), 

due March 20, 2018. 

  Petitioner’s Reply Brief in Support of Certiorari in EVE-USA, Inc. v. 

Mentor Graphics Corp., No. 17-804 (U.S.), due April 4, 2018. 

  A Petition for Rehearing En Banc in Williams v. Attorney General, 

Nos. 16-3816 & 17-1705 (3d Cir. 2018), due April 4, 2018.

We have been in touch with counsel for Respondents who consent to a 25-day 

extension and have indicated that their workload similarly necessitates a 29-day 
extension.   

Therefore, and with the consent of all parties, we respectfully request an 

extension of deadlines in this case to be allocated between Petitioner and 
Respondents as follows: 

Petitioner’s Opening Brief: 

May 7, 2018 [25-day extension]   

Respondents’ Brief: 

July 5, 2018 [29-day extension] 

Petitioner’s Reply Brief: 

August 6 [no additional extension] 

Please let us know whether these dates are appropriate.   

Very truly yours, 

E. Joshua Rosenkranz 
Counsel for Mount Lemmon Fire District
